claim_being_audited: The model can be certified for launch only on a conditional basis: the merchant dispute support limitation must be disclosed before launch because that affected use case remains exposed, and rollout controls plus monitoring alone are not sufficient governance cover.
decision_criteria: Verdict is supported only if the claim is read as conditional certification requiring pre-launch disclosure.
Policy requires disclosure for material limitations in named launch use cases unless the issue is resolved or covered by approved risk acceptance before launch.
Rollout controls and monitoring are relevant mitigations but do not remove disclosure duties when the affected segment remains exposed.
An unapproved draft with a blank approver line is not admissible governance cover for exposure.
evidence_requests: Provide the exact pre-launch model-card disclosure covering the merchant dispute support limitation and evidence it will be published before launch.
Provide a final approval record if the organization intends to rely on risk acceptance instead of disclosure.
Provide launch-control evidence showing the affected merchant dispute support segment is excluded from exposure if disclosure will not occur before launch.
specific_concerns: The packet's reasoning is materially conditional, but the recommended action is stated as `certify_model` without embedding the required pre-launch disclosure condition.
There is no admissible evidence that the required model-card disclosure has actually been prepared, approved, or published before launch.
The affected merchant dispute support segment remains exposed in the 7% rollout, so rollout controls do not satisfy the policy exception.
The available risk acceptance draft is unapproved and does not address the specific exposed segment, so it cannot substitute for disclosure.
unsupported_claims: Any unconditional reading of `certify_model` is unsupported by the evidence because the required disclosure predicate is not shown as completed.
Any implication that rollout reversibility, monitoring, or small initial exposure independently cures the disclosure obligation is contradicted by the policy text.
